author: Walt Disney Imagineering YouTube
text:
So, what’s the secret to designing Nemo Reef Water Play?
Shanghai Disney Enchanted Star Hotel opens December 16, bringing new stories and family adventures to life. 🌟✨

For its indoor water-play experience inspired by Disney and Pixar's Finding Nemo and Finding Dory, Imagineers used color, light and water as storytelling tools, transforming the space into an immersive underwater world for families to explore, play and discover together. 🌊🐠
